post.title: Fast, reproducible NixOS virtual machines on macOS and Windows
post.subtitle: One NixOS configuration, tuned virtual machines, and a consistent Linux environment across host operating systems.
post.content:
This post is being written.

I’ll cover how I structure the NixOS configuration, share it across machines, and tune the virtualization layer for good filesystem, networking, and CPU performance on both macOS and Windows.
